title: Installation Price Board and Set Savings — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Installation price board — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** Charges per tire rung on a tire ticket, the set savings and the ticket size limit for each line. Prices are pre-tax.

| Line | Mount and balance, per tire | New rubber valve stem, per tire | TPMS sensor service kit, per tire | Scrap tire handling fee, per old tire taken off |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | $21.00 | $3.50 | $6.99 | $3.75 |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | $21.00 | $3.50 | $6.99 | $3.75 |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | $25.00 | $3.50 | $6.99 | $3.75 |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | $29.00 | $4.50 | $7.99 | $4.25 |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | $25.00 | $3.50 | $6.99 | $3.75 |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | $25.00 | $3.50 | $6.99 | $3.75 |

A valve stem is not charged on a tire where a TPMS service kit is used; the TPMS kit is the charge for vehicles with direct TPMS.

| Line | Set instant savings, per ticket | Tires of the line needed on one ticket | Most tires on one ticket (a matching full-size spare counts) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | $0.00 | 4 | 4 |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | $40.00 | 4 | 4 |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | $60.00 | 4 | 4 |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | $50.00 | 4 | 5 |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | $80.00 | 4 | 4 |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | $100.00 | 4 | 4 |

**Savings threshold, both sides (hypothetical tickets):** a ticket of 4 tires of the Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty line receives the $80.00 set instant savings; a ticket of 3 tires of that line does not. The Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty line carries no set savings ($0.00). Only the Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty line allows 5 tires on one ticket.
